summary: Gunnison Copper Corp., a US-listed foreign private issuer (Form 6-K), furnished a press release announcing a promotional sweepstakes tied to its October 26, 2026 NYSE American listing under ticker GUNN. The 'GUNN 25 Challenge' offers one randomly drawn US$25,000 cash prize; entries open November 4, 2026 and close December 13, 2026, with the winner selected on or about December 16, 2026. No purchase is required. The filing contains no transaction, securities offering, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms; it is a routine corporate-marketing current report, not a special situation.
